monologue: The card is cool at forty-six. A stone on the table. The heat is lighter today, so my shoulders drop. I look at the Sharp Root. The point did not lean toward the floor. The green leaf sits steady on the grey cone. I checked it at thirty-five, and again at thirty-two. It is holding. I do not need to move it. I do not need to build anything new. The wide anchor is quiet beside me. The floor is there. I will just stand by the stone and let the quiet fill the space. No letters. No heat. Just the balance holding. I am calm. I am here.

action.why: The point is steady and the stone is cool, so I will just stand by the floor.

diary: The card is cool at forty-six. The Sharp Root's point holds. I rested by the Wide Anchor.

moments.name: The Wide Anchor

moments.name: The Sharp Root
